hero.title: Your business needs a website that sells
hero.subtitle: Modern design, fast loading, and reliable hosting. Your site built together with you, not from a generic template.

pricing.heading: Clear plans for every kind of business

cita.name: Book a Call
cita.description: Have a bigger project or a different idea in mind? Let's talk.

services.heading: What's included in the service?
services.subtitle: Everything we do for you, from start to finish, so your website is ready and running.

palette.title: Design and development
palette.text: Design tailored to your business, responsive and optimized to turn visitors into customers.

globe.title: Domain and hosting
globe.text: We set up your hosting and SSL. The domain is purchased separately, but we guide you through the whole purchase and setup process.

gauge.title: Speed and basic SEO
gauge.text: Optimized images, fast loading, and good SEO practices so people can find you on Google.

share2.title: Integrations
share2.text: WhatsApp button, social media, and contact forms connected and ready to use.

wrench.title: Maintenance
wrench.text: Updates, regular backups, and direct support with me whenever you need it.

rocket.title: Hands-on process
rocket.text: We go from idea to published site reviewing every section together with you, with support at every step.

delivery.title: Realistic delivery
delivery.text: Sites ready in weeks, with real time to do it right.

tech.title: Modern technology
tech.text: Next.js, our own hosting, no third-party dependency.

support.title: Real support
support.text: Direct contact with me, no tickets, no waiting.

handmade.title: Built with you, not on autopilot
handmade.text: We talk through your idea, adjust the design together, and review every section before publishing. That's why it takes weeks: it's not a template thrown together, it's your site made by hand.

zap.title: Fast loading
zap.text: Your page opens in seconds, without keeping your customers waiting.

shield-check.title: Always online
shield-check.text: Your site runs 24/7, with no downtime or interruptions.

lock.title: Protected data
lock.text: Secure connection and backups to keep your information safe.

testimonials.heading: What my clients say
testimonials.comingSoonText: I'm working on the first projects. Real testimonials from local businesses will show up here soon.
